events.text: Round 5 — WORLD editor gaps (old hmsc-int world editor vs cart/editor world surface). User caveat honored: old prop-TS-file system is NOT to be ported — studio models are the one prop source; what ports is the BROWSING/APPLY UX. (X) PIECE SKIN FLOW: old = select placed piece -> FACES panel w/ per-face thumbnail slots (front/back/sides) + inline skin thumbnail grid + search + palette pages + hex; ONE click on a skin fills ALL face slots AND the viewport updates instantly; 'copy skin -> brush' button. New = pieceSlots/PieceBody slot rows exist (req_2563 Ph4) + live skin boxes render (pieceSkins req_2575 B) BUT: two-step indirect flow (pick material in content browser THEN click slot row), no inline skin thumbnails, no one-click-all-faces, no copy-skin-to-brush. Also wall slots pared to front/back (old had sides); per-face six-slot granularity deferred. Also pieceSkins only handles shader materials — image-texture skins unclear. (Y) BUILD PALETTE THUMBNAILS: old build menu shows actual piece GEOMETRY thumbs (28 walls incl authored glass_door_retail etc) + props tab w/ search, tags, and 'related' results. New BuildBar = color chip + text label only — while modelThumb.ts (ported railThumbGrid pipeline) already renders 3D thumbs in the library; not wired into BuildBar. No prop browser w/ search/tags/related in world surface at all. (Z) PLACED AUTHORED MESHES DRAW UNTEXTURED — meshProps.ts writes mesh-only lumps, painted atlas 'a later slice': placed studio models lose their paint in the world editor. (AA) CHUNK CONTROL: old 2D tile map had chunk rail (A0/B0/...) + declare-new-chunk + attachment point. New editor only seeds chunk 0,0 via mapGrowChunk(0,0) when empty (mapPaint.ts:138) — the HOST DOOR EXISTS (mapGrowChunk x,y), zero UI to grow/attach chunks. (BB) Old-world PROPERTIES tile-focus panel ruled IGNORE by user ('it was always fucked') — do not port.
